#RIVER v1
# Solver-graded river decisions (postflop-lab, tools/riverdrills). One RIVER line per spot,
# 24 '|' separated fields in this order (amounts in big blinds, 2 decimals):
#  0 RIVER
#  1 id            H0001.. heads-up, T0001.. three-way
#  2 n=            players in the pot (2 or 3)
#  3 pool=         home (opponents leaned to the owner's game) | general (ordinary opponents)
#  4 style=        opponent style(s), ',' separated in seat order of 'villains'
#  5 hero=         hero's seat (UTG UTG+1 LJ HJ CO BTN SB BB, 8-handed names)
#  6 villains=     opponents' seats, ',' separated
#  7 order=        river action order of all players in the pot, ',' separated
#  8 stack=        starting stack of the hand
#  9 hand=         hero's cards, e.g. AsKd
# 10 board=        five cards, e.g. Kc7h2d9s3c
# 11 line=         the hand so far in one sentence (no '|')
# 12 pot=          chips in the middle at the decision, bets on the river included
# 13 call=         amount to call (0.00 when nobody has bet)
# 14 behind=       hero's chips behind
# 15 decision=     first | checked_to | facing ; then ':' and the bet as a share of the pot before it (facing only)
# 16 opts=         ';' separated code:amount:ev_bb:ev_pct_pot. code: check fold call bet33 bet75 bet150 raise allin
#                  (three-way bets: bet33 bet75). amount: total put in on the river by that option ('-' for check, fold)
# 17 best=         code of the best option
# 18 accept=       ',' codes graded correct. clear: one play (bet sizes may be several). either: a near-tie
# 19 verdict=      clear | either
# 20 gap=          best option's lead over the best option of another play, % of the pot ; then ':' noise in bb
# 21 split=        hero vs the range he faces (facing: the bettor's range; else the whole range, three-way: first
#                  villain in order): beat:tie:lose shares ; then '/' you_beat as what:share,... ; then '/' beats_you
# 22 kind=         value thin_value bluff overbet check bluff_catch strong_vs_bet air_vs_bet raise
# 23 why=          the explanation, at most three sentences joined by ' ~ '
#meta spots=1328 heads_up=1016 three_way=312 clear=848 either=480
